note: Keys that are not (g . posint) and values at or above 2^64 - 1 go to the escape table, an equal hash table that rehashes as it grows. The composed catalog should only escape a sequence reaching 2^64 - 1 (the count is unbounded); no theorem proves the escape stays empty under the catalog's reachable states, so the Theta(N) rehash step is not excluded. Owed: either an emptiness invariant over fn-cat$pcorr states (with teeth: a state that does escape) or a bound on its size.
title: Dense map: the escape table is not proved empty on the composed catalog (Codex r44 F2)
